name: mumr
description: Start and stop Mumr meeting recordings on your Mac, and read the meetings Mumr saved there, from an assistant that has a shell on that Mac. Needs Mumr for Mac.

interface.shortDescription: Start and stop Mumr recordings on your Mac
interface.longDescription: Ask the assistant to start or stop a Mumr recording, open a meeting in Mumr, or answer questions from the meetings Mumr saved on your Mac. Runs only in threads that run locally on a Mac with Mumr installed.
defaultPrompt: Start recording this meeting in Mumr.
What did we decide in my last Mumr meeting?
